t: 諸葛大名垂宇宙，宗臣遺跡尚高風。
c: 诸葛大名垂宇宙，宗臣遗迹尚高风。
p: Zhū gě dà míng chuí yǔ zhòu, zōng chén yí jì shàng gāo fēng.
z: ㄓㄨ ㄍㄜˇ ㄉㄚˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄔㄨㄟˊ ㄩˇ ㄓㄡˋ ， ㄗㄨㄥ ㄔㄣˊ ㄧˊ ㄐㄧ ㄕㄤˋ ㄍㄠ ㄈㄥ 。
en: The great name of Zhuge Liang hangs forever over the universe; the revered statesman's legacy still commands a lofty respect.

wg.en: to hang down / to hand down (to posterity)

t: 三分割據紆籌策，萬古雲霄一羽毛。
c: 三分割据纡筹策，万古云霄一羽毛。
p: Sān fēn gē jù yū chóu cè, wàn gǔ yún xiāo yī yǔ máo.
z: ㄙㄢ ㄈㄣ ㄍㄜ ㄐㄩˋ ㄩ ㄔㄡˊ ㄘㄜˋ ， ㄨㄢˋ ㄍㄨˇ ㄩㄣˊ ㄒㄧㄠ ㄧ ㄩˇ ㄇㄠˊ 。
en: He painstakingly devised strategies for the partition into the Three Kingdoms; throughout the ages, he soars like a single feather in the clouds, unique and unmatched.

wg.en: a single feather (metaphor for rarity and high integrity)

t: 伯仲之間見伊呂，指揮若定失蕭曹。
c: 伯仲之间见伊吕，指挥若定失萧曹。
p: Bó zhòng zhī jiān jiàn yī lǚ, zhǐ huī ruò dìng shī xiāo cáo.
z: ㄅㄛˊ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄓ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄧ ㄌㄩˇ ， ㄓˇ ㄏㄨㄟ ㄖㄨㄛˋ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄕ ㄒㄧㄠ ㄘㄠˊ 。
en: In rank and talent, he stands equal to Yi Yin and Lu Shang; in command and governance, Xiao He and Cao Shen would pale in comparison.

wg.en: between elder and younger brothers / on par with / equal to
Yi Yin and Lu Shang (ancient sages)
Xiao He and Cao Shen (famous Han ministers)

t: 運移漢祚終難復，志決身殲軍務勞。
c: 运移汉祚终难复，志决身歼军务劳。
p: Yùn yí hàn zuò zhōng nán fù, zhì jué shēn jiān jūn wù láo.
z: ㄩㄣˋ ㄧˊ ㄏㄢˋ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄋㄢˊ ㄈㄨˋ ， ㄓˋ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄕㄣ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄐㄩㄣ ㄨˋ ㄌㄠˊ 。
en: But fate shifted, and the Han lineage could not be restored; with resolved will, he perished, exhausted by military duties.

wg.en: the reign/lineage of the Han Dynasty
